name: ACCOUNT_SCOPE_20261104
comment: ANCHOR: FQ-096 / SPEC_ONE_POSITION_VERDICT §1b rule 3. canonical_observation.py defaulted
account_scope=ALL_ACCOUNTS, so a residual in one account could read as held everywhere. The tests
pin an unscoped default that cannot claim all accounts, an explicit scope that propagates, and
(symbol, account) holdings semantics: an Individual residual never holds an IRA position.
